newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton ends higher in rangebound, thin trade.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton ends higher in rangebound, thin trade.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures settled slightly firmer while players remained cautious ahead of Friday's key U.S. Department of Agriculture report, industry sources said.
Trade selling above 76.00 in December capped the market at its highs and local and speculative short covering supported the market above the 40-day and 50-day moving averages between 75.00 and 75.30.
Prices traded narrowly as the most-active December contract finished 0.38 higher after ranging from 76.40 to 75.50. The deferred contracts settled 0.44 higher to 0.15 lower.

The market expects the USDA to peg the crop close to its previous report at 17.9 million 480-lb bales, and put the forecast between 18.2 million and 17.5 million bales. The range has already been filtered into the market, dealers said.
